title: Past simple or present perfect - Advanced distinction and usage

options.answer: I have lived in London for three years when I was a child.
I lived in London for three years when I was a child.
I am living in London for three years when I was a child.

explanation.en: Past simple is used for completed actions in the past with specific time references like 'when I was a child'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее простое время используется для завершенных действий в прошлом с конкретными временными указаниями, такими как 'когда я был ребенком'.
explanation.uz: O'tgan sodda zamon o'tmishda tugallangan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi, masalan 'bola bo'lganimda' kabi aniq vaqt ko'rsatkichlari bilan.

options.answer: She has never been to Paris.
She never went to Paris.
She never has been to Paris.

explanation.en: Present perfect is used with 'never' to express life experiences without specific time references.
explanation.ru: Настоящее совершенное время используется с 'never' для выражения жизненного опыта без конкретных временных указаний.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi mukammal zamon 'never' bilan hayotiy tajribalarni ifodalash uchun aniq vaqt ko'rsatkichlarsiz ishlatiladi.

options.answer: I have finished my homework yesterday.
I finished my homework yesterday.
I am finishing my homework yesterday.

explanation.en: Past simple is used with specific past time expressions like 'yesterday', not present perfect.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее простое время используется с конкретными прошедшими временными выражениями, такими как 'вчера', а не настоящее совершенное.
explanation.uz: 'Kecha' kabi aniq o'tmish vaqt ifodalari bilan o'tgan sodda zamon ishlatiladi, hozirgi mukammal zamon emas.

options.answer: They lived here since 2010.
They have lived here since 2010.
They are living here since 2010.

explanation.en: Present perfect is used with 'since' to show actions continuing from a past point to now.
explanation.ru: Настоящее совершенное время используется с 'since' для обозначения действий, продолжающихся с прошлого момента до настоящего.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi mukammal zamon 'since' bilan o'tmishdagi nuqtadan hozirgi vaqtgacha davom etayotgan harakatlarni ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: Have you ever went to Italy?
Did you ever go to Italy?
Have you ever been to Italy?

explanation.en: Present perfect with 'ever' asks about life experiences, and 'been' is the correct past participle of 'go' for places visited.
explanation.ru: Настоящее совершенное время с 'ever' спрашивает о жизненном опыте, и 'been' является правильным причастием прошедшего времени от 'go' для посещенных мест.
explanation.uz: 'Ever' bilan hozirgi mukammal zamon hayotiy tajriba haqida so'raydi, va 'been' tashrif buyurilgan joylar uchun 'go' fe'lining to'g'ri o'tmish sifatdoshidir.

options.answer: I have seen that movie last week.
I saw that movie last week.
I see that movie last week.

explanation.en: Past simple is used with specific time expressions like 'last week', not present perfect.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее простое время используется с конкретными временными выражениями, такими как 'на прошлой неделе', а не настоящее совершенное.
explanation.uz: 'O'tgan hafta' kabi aniq vaqt ifodalari bilan o'tgan sodda zamon ishlatiladi, hozirgi mukammal zamon emas.

options.answer: We have just arrived.
We just arrived.
We are just arriving.

explanation.en: Present perfect is used with 'just' to express recent actions with current relevance.
explanation.ru: Настоящее совершенное время используется с 'just' для выражения недавних действий с текущей актуальностью.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi mukammal zamon 'just' bilan hozirgi vaqtga aloqasi bor so'nggi harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: She has worked there from 2015 to 2020.
She worked there from 2015 to 2020.
She is working there from 2015 to 2020.

explanation.en: Past simple is used for completed actions with a definite finished time period like 'from 2015 to 2020'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее простое время используется для завершенных действий с определенным законченным временным периодом, таким как 'с 2015 по 2020'.
explanation.uz: O'tgan sodda zamon '2015 yildan 2020 yilgacha' kabi aniq tugagan vaqt davri bilan tugallangan harakatlar uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: I have already finished my work.
I already finished my work.
I am already finishing my work.

explanation.en: Present perfect is used with 'already' to emphasize completed actions with present relevance.
explanation.ru: Настоящее совершенное время используется с 'already' для подчеркивания завершенных действий с настоящей актуальностью.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi mukammal zamon 'already' bilan hozirgi vaqtga aloqasi bor tugallangan harakatlarni ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

options.answer: How long do you live here?
How long have you lived here?
How long did you live here?

explanation.en: Present perfect is used with 'How long' to ask about duration from past to present.
explanation.ru: Настоящее совершенное время используется с 'How long' для вопроса о продолжительности от прошлого к настоящему.
explanation.uz: Hozirgi mukammal zamon 'How long' bilan o'tmishdan hozirgi vaqtgacha bo'lgan davomiylik haqida so'rash uchun ishlatiladi.
